record: Padise Monastery permanent exhibition on its architecture
facts: A square garden court anchored the cloister. The north range houses the church and its larger tracery windows, with a surviving north-east bartizan. A second outer courtyard and square gatehouse and tower are at the west. In the southern range the ceilings have collapsed.
The monastery reopened in May 2020 following extensive conservation and renovation.
The 14th-century Cistercian monastery contains earlier limestone buildings. It opened again in 2020. The neighboring manor is a distinct building outside the monastery.
